terms.comment: A modern sport application of an old noun.
Classically a wicker basket, for fruit or grain (Cic., Varr.), masculine or feminine. Traupman’s word, with corbifollem per corbem injicere, “make a basket”.

sources: Lewis & Short: canistrum · Lewis & Short: corbis
